name: Tortoise Derby
subtitle: The slowest tortoise wins
shortDescription: Cheer for last place. Hand out order cards, outwit puddles, mud and wind, and let your gold-caped Champion finish behind everyone. 100 races plus a Daily Race.
longDescription:
Every other race game rewards the fast one. In Tortoise Derby the prize goes to the tortoise who arrives LAST.

Three or four clay tortoises plod down hand-made terracotta lanes. One wears gold silks: your Champion. Hand out a few order cards, ring the bell, and watch a stop-motion round unfold. If the Champion crosses the line after every rival, you win.

### Order Cards
Hurry adds a step. Nap keeps a tortoise still. Swap trades places with the neighbouring lane. Every card spends from a small purse, and the fewest cards earns three stars.

### Lanes with Character
Puddles halt a move, spring leaves add a step, mud takes one away, tail and head winds change a whole lane, and token markets pay out an extra card when a move ends on them.

100 RACES IN TEN WORLDS
From Meadow Mile to the Golden Cup, each world adds one twist: twin Champions, relay swaps, token markets and more. Every race is checked by a solver, so a clean win always exists.

### More to Do
Daily Race: a fresh course every day with a streak bonus. Grand Tour: an endless road that grows harder. The Stable: earn clay and collect 24 clay shells (odds shown in the game).

### Calm By Design
No timers, nothing to lose: undo a round or restart whenever you like. Music, haptics and a calm-motion mode can be switched off.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
